issue.title: Fix again javadoc stylesheet
issue.body: Previously we had a nice javadoc stylesheet. That worked well with JDK6. Then we used travis that was only allowing OracleJDK7, that came with a better javadoc stylesheet so we dropped ours. Now since the release of mockito 2.x is using openjdk6, we should reintroduce a better stylesheet. Current state ❌ http://site.mockito.org/mockito/docs/2.0.100-beta/org/mockito/Mockito.html Previous ✅ http://site.mockito.org/mockito/docs/2.0.0-beta/org/mockito/Mockito.html
